questions.question_text: When inspecting etl and sql aggregation, which implementation claim is supported by the module lessons?

options.text:
No ML model exists in this project. The core processing is deterministic aggregation:
groupBy + sum/mean over filtered rows, monthly bucketing by calendar month, and a sales-weighted
discount mean (`Σ(discount·sales)/Σ(sales)`). Margin % is `profit/sales`. Sub-category profitability
is a signed sum of profit used for diverging bars.

Connect this explanation to `sql/retail_analysis.sql` and the source focus `SELECT`.
A polished interface proves that every advertised model and backend feature is implemented.
A single overall accuracy value is sufficient to establish reliability on every population and input condition.
If a score is numeric, it is a calibrated probability and can directly determine a consequential action.
